name.en: Arthenée the Defender of Sacred Silence
name.ja: <ruby>聖<rt>せい</rt></ruby><ruby>寂<rt>じゃく</rt></ruby>の<ruby>護<rt>まも</rt></ruby>り<ruby>手<rt>て</rt></ruby>アルテネ

summoning_condition.en: You can Special Summon this card from your hand face-up to your field by revealing 1 other Union monster in your hand.

requirement.en: Send the top 2 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard.

effect.en: Equip this card to 1 face-up monster on your field as an Equip Spell Card with the following effect. ● The equipped monster gains 1000 ATK, and during your turn, your opponent cannot activate Trap Cards when it declares an attack.
